title: Google KILLED the Future of Smartphones!
description:
Google almost changed the smartphone industry forever, then completely wiped it out. 🤯

In 2014, they introduced Project Ara—a revolutionary modular smartphone made of detachable blocks. Imagine a Lego-style phone where you could instantly upgrade your battery, swap out a broken screen, or add a better camera without buying a whole new device. It threatened the entire mobile industry, but then Google suddenly killed it. Why do you think they canceled it? Let me know in the comments! 👇

#shorts #tech #google #projectara #smartphone #technology #gadgets #retrothetech #fail
